README: The tracked delivery plan for cloud journeys. Each status is a claim that src/release/acceptance.ts checks against this repository (test/acceptance-journeys.test.ts). There is no COMPLETE status. SYNTHETIC_PASS proves software behavior with fake engines; LIVE_PASS needs owner-authorized evidence naming the source commit, target, engine and outcome. Neither stands in for the other.

ui.title: AWS Terraform in the console: prepare from a project folder, preview, approve and apply through the real router, service and adapter

positive.title: Terraform on AWS: the request and manifest come from the contract and the project, and bind exactly as seal binds them

denied.title: owner prerequisites stop preparation with the owner named, and never offer another path around them

interrupted.title: the files are private, named by the manifest hash, and written all or nothing

recovery.title: a project changed after preparation is no longer current, and its old manifest no longer binds

denied.title: the backend init saved must be the contract's bucket, key and region with native locking; anything else is refused at seal (the plan embeds it) and before the approvals are consumed at apply

interrupted.title: a dialog that times out, or is canceled, ends the command with nothing run and nothing spent

recovery.title: qualify, seal and apply sweep stale scratch directories at startup, as the teardown CLI does, and leave young ones and other names alone
